+"""Additional continuous enclosure checks for the rendered robot's real tool geometry.
+
+The existing arm certificate covers link capsules, but not the wider gripper,
+wrist connector or pedestal. These bounds match spatial_scene_props.mechanism.
+"""
+import math
+from .spatial_suite import kinematics as k,pick_place as pp
+
+
+def tool_geometry(mech,q):
+    points=k.fk(mech,q);elbow,tip=points[2:]
+    length=math.dist(elbow,tip)
+    wrist=[tip[i]-.13*(tip[i]-elbow[i])/length for i in range(3)]
+    connector=[tip[0],tip[1],tip[2]+.085]
+    box=[tip[0]-.105,tip[0]+.105,tip[1]-.03,tip[1]+.03,tip[2]-.04,tip[2]+.10]
+    return points,wrist,connector,box
+
+
+def _box_gap(a,b):
+    return math.sqrt(sum(max(a[2*i]-b[2*i+1],b[2*i]-a[2*i+1],0)**2 for i in range(3)))
+
+
+def check_tool_motion(task,sub):
+    clean=k.check_motion(task,sub)
+    if not clean['valid_output']:return dict(ok=False,reason='invalid_output')
+    mech=clean['mechanism'];keys=sub['keyframes'];base=mech['base']
+    pedestal=[base[0]-.125,base[0]+.125,base[1]-.125,base[1]+.125,0,.025]
+    fixed=[]
+    for obstacle in task['obstacles']:
+        gap=_box_gap(pedestal,obstacle['box'])
+        post=k._seg_box_dist([*base,0],[*base,k.POST_H],obstacle['box'],.01)-k.RADIUS
+        fixed.append(dict(obstacle=obstacle['id'],pedestal_gap_m=gap,post_clearance_m=post,ok=min(gap,post)>=k.CLEARANCE))
+    events,error=pp._events(task,sub,len(keys))
+    if error:return dict(ok=False,reason=error,fixed=fixed)
+    span=pp._timeline(task,events);rows=[]
+    # The connector endpoint at the wrist has the same link-point motion bound as the tip.
+    lever=k._lever(mech)
+    for n,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(keys,keys[1:])):
+        sweep=sum(abs(math.radians(b[j]-a[j]))*lever[j] for j in range(3))
+        steps=max(1,math.ceil(sweep/.005));worst=float('inf');why=''
+        rest=pp._resting(task,span,n)
+        for s in range(steps+1):
+            q=[a[j]+s/steps*(b[j]-a[j]) for j in range(3)]
+            pts,wrist,end,box=tool_geometry(mech,q)
+            checks=[(box[4],'gripper floor'),(min(wrist[2],end[2])-.018,'connector floor'),
+                    (k._seg_box_dist(pts[1],pts[2],box,.01)-k.RADIUS,'gripper link1'),
+                    (k._seg_box_dist(pts[0],pts[1],box,.01)-k.RADIUS,'gripper post'),
+                    (k._seg_seg_dist(wrist,end,pts[0],pts[1])-.018-k.RADIUS,'connector post')]
+            for obstacle in task['obstacles']+[dict(id='pedestal',box=pedestal)]:
+                checks.extend([(_box_gap(box,obstacle['box']),'gripper '+obstacle['id']),
+                               (k._seg_box_dist(wrist,end,obstacle['box'],.01)-.018,'connector '+obstacle['id'])])
+            for bid,position in rest:
+                pointbox=[v for x in position for v in (x,x)]
+                checks.extend([(_box_gap(box,pointbox)-pp.RADIUS,'gripper resting '+bid),
+                               (k._seg_seg_dist(wrist,end,position,position)-.018-pp.RADIUS,'connector resting '+bid)])
+            value,culprit=min(checks)
+            if value<worst:worst,why=value,culprit
+        margin=worst-sweep/steps/2
+        rows.append(dict(segment=n,certified_margin_m=margin,closest=why,ok=margin>=k.CLEARANCE))
+    return dict(ok=clean['all_ok'] and all(r['ok'] for r in fixed+rows),arm_ok=clean['all_ok'],fixed=fixed,segments=rows,
+                scope='Conservative enclosure certificate; requires separately verified rendered mesh enclosure; no force dynamics')

+                elif name.startswith('moving link 1') or name.startswith('joint 1'):category='link1';segment=points[1:3];radius=k.RADIUS
+                elif name.startswith('moving link 2') or name.startswith('joint 2'):category='link2';segment=points[2:4];radius=k.RADIUS

+import math
+
+
+def compare_views(reference,candidate):
+    for key in ('camera','width','height'):
+        if key not in reference or reference[key]!=candidate.get(key):raise ValueError('Native camera/raster mismatch')
+    length=reference['width']*reference['height']
+    for view in (reference,candidate):
+        if len(view.get('visible_ids',[]))!=length or len(view.get('visible_depth_m',[]))!=length:raise ValueError('Complete actual-triangle pixel evidence required')
+    gold,cand=reference['visible_ids'],candidate['visible_ids']
+    names=(set(gold)|set(cand))-{None}
+    if not names:raise ValueError('No measurable native foreground')
+    iou={}
+    for name in sorted(names):
+        intersection=sum(a==name and b==name for a,b in zip(gold,cand))
+        union=sum(a==name or b==name for a,b in zip(gold,cand))
+        iou[name]=intersection/union

+def quarter_rotate(x,y,yaw):

+def box_sweep_hit(moving,fixed,start,end,epsilon=1e-6):
+    """Whether component boxes overlap during a fixed-yaw linear translation."""
+    lower,upper=0.,1.
+    for axis in range(3):
+        lo=fixed[axis][0]-moving[axis][1]+epsilon
+        hi=fixed[axis][1]-moving[axis][0]-epsilon
+        delta=end[axis]-start[axis]
+        if abs(delta)<1e-12:
+            if not lo<start[axis]<hi:return False
+            continue

+        lower=max(lower,min(a,b));upper=min(upper,max(a,b))
+        if upper<=lower:return False

+"""Explicit native reward components; infrastructure and inapplicable metrics stay distinct."""
+import math
+
+
+def fraction(numerator,denominator):return numerator/denominator if denominator else None
+
+
+def stage_reward(stage):
+    geometry=stage.get('geometry',{});scope=stage.get('stage_scope')
+    valid=stage.get('reason') not in ('invalid_output','no_submission','local_evaluation_failure') and geometry.get('valid_output',True)
+    issues=scope['violations'] if scope is not None else stage.get('physical',geometry.get('physical',[]))
+    safe=bool(valid and not issues and not stage.get('locked_moved') and stage.get('native_report',{}).get('ok',True))
+    components=dict(functional_success=float(bool(stage.get('success'))))
+    for name,numerator,denominator in [('constraints','satisfied','total'),('hard_constraints','hard_satisfied','hard_total'),('feasible_soft','soft_feasible_ok','soft_feasible_total'),('true_constraints','true_satisfied','total'),('waypoints','waypoints_ok','waypoints'),('motion_segments','segments_ok','segments'),('preservation','preserved','preserved_total')]:
+        if numerator in stage and denominator in stage:
+            value=fraction(stage[numerator],stage[denominator])
+            if value is not None:components[name]=value
+    for prefix,name in [('conflict','infeasibility_f1'),('detect','checker_f1')]:
+        if prefix+'_tp' in stage:
+            tp=stage[prefix+'_tp'];denominator=2*tp+stage[prefix+'_fp']+stage[prefix+'_fn']
+            if denominator:components[name]=2*tp/denominator
+    for key in ('hidden_mean_iou','metric_centres_ok','limits_ok','payload_ok'):
+        if stage.get(key) is not None:components[key]=float(stage[key])
+    if stage.get('operation_checks'):components['operation_targets']=sum(row['ok'] for row in stage['operation_checks'])/len(stage['operation_checks'])
+    if 'unnecessary_clean_disturbed' in stage:components['clean_preservation']=1/(1+len(stage['unnecessary_clean_disturbed']))
+    if any(not math.isfinite(value) or not 0<=value<=1 for value in components.values()):raise ValueError('Invalid evaluator reward component')

+"""Publish a reviewed release without rewriting history or replacing concurrent commits."""
+import argparse,hashlib,json,os,subprocess,tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+from scripts.audit_public_release import audit
+from scripts.public_reproduce import verify
+
+
+def git(checkout,*args,env=None,data=None):
+    result=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(checkout),*args],input=data,text=True,capture_output=True,env=env)
+    if result.returncode:raise RuntimeError(result.stderr.strip())
+    return result.stdout.strip()
+
+
+def commit_tree(checkout,source,parent,message):
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
+        env=dict(os.environ,GIT_INDEX_FILE=str(Path(tmp)/'index'),GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='CounterScene-3D Contributors',GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='contributors@example.invalid',GIT_COMMITTER_NAME='CounterScene-3D Contributors',GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL='contributors@example.invalid')
+        directory=git(checkout,'rev-parse','--absolute-git-dir')
+        def index(*args):
+            result=subprocess.run(['git','--git-dir',directory,'--work-tree',str(source.resolve()),'-c','core.autocrlf=false',*args],env=env,text=True,capture_output=True)
+            if result.returncode:raise RuntimeError(result.stderr.strip())
+            return result.stdout.strip()
+        index('read-tree','--empty');index('add','--all','--','.')
+        tree=index('write-tree')
+        for path in source.rglob('*'):
+            if not path.is_file():continue
+            relative=path.relative_to(source).as_posix();actual=git(checkout,'cat-file','blob',tree+':'+relative)
+            # Byte identity is checked with binary output; text conversion above is diagnostic only.
+            raw=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(checkout),'cat-file','blob',tree+':'+relative],capture_output=True,check=True).stdout
+            if hashlib.sha256(raw).digest()!=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).digest():raise ValueError('Git staging changed release bytes')
+        return git(checkout,'commit-tree',tree,'-p',parent,env=env,data=message+'\n')
+
+
+def run(a):
+    manifest=json.loads((a.release/'release_manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'));verify(a.release,manifest['files'])
+    if not audit(a.release)['passed']:raise ValueError('Release privacy/content gate failed')
+    if git(a.checkout,'remote','get-url','origin').removesuffix('.git')!='https://github.com/mikelyfei/CounterScene-3D':raise ValueError('Unexpected publication destination')
+    git(a.checkout,'fetch','origin','main','gh-pages')
+    heads={branch:git(a.checkout,'rev-parse','origin/'+branch) for branch in ('main','gh-pages')}
+    main=commit_tree(a.checkout,a.release,heads['main'],'Publish reproducible native-asset benchmark and research results')
+    pages=commit_tree(a.checkout,a.release/'site',heads['gh-pages'],'Publish interactive benchmark, model trajectories and study evidence')
+    if not a.execute:print('Prepared ancestry-preserving commits; no remote writes');return
+    git(a.checkout,'push','origin',main+':refs/heads/main')
+    git(a.checkout,'push','origin',pages+':refs/heads/gh-pages')
+    print('Pushed main and gh-pages. Live deployment verification is still required.')
+
+
+if __name__=='__main__':
+    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--release',type=Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--checkout',type=Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--execute',action='store_true');run(p.parse_args())
